title: Taylor flying cargo jets between Florida and Nassau

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Timothy Taylor, a man he describes as being studied by NASA, the US space agency, because UFOs are said to show up around him. Michels says that Taylor writes in his autobiography, Launch Fever, about flying cargo jets back and forth between Florida and Nassau in the Bahamas. It is told as part of Taylor's background as a working pilot.
